subject: Catalyst Marketplace: ISV listing packaging & co-sell playbook for Stratus pilot
messages:
From: Stratus Labs Partnerships <partners@stratuslabs.io>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@stratuslabs.io>
Date: Wed, 08 Oct 2025 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Listing & co-sell: Stratus pilot (initial ask)

Hi Olga,

Thanks for agreeing to help — we're excited to pilot Stratus Labs' log-analytics ISV bundle with Redwood on AWS/Azure/GCP marketplaces. High level asks from our side:

- Confirmation of the minimal evidence set required for a 1st-party listing (SOC 2/PCI if applicable, billing SKU requirements, sample listing metadata).
- A short mutual action plan so we can align internal PMs and procurement on deadlines.
- Clarify Redwood's co-sell entitlements and any preferred joint-marketing assets.

We're aiming for a canary listing window in late Oct; can you confirm whether that timeline is feasible and who on the Redwood side will own the co-sell deck and marketplace evidence checklist?

Attaching a draft SOW (we'll send a tracked-changes version shortly).

Warmly,
Elena Ramos
Head of Partnerships, Stratus Labs
Elena Ramos | +1 (415) 555-0123
[attachment: initial-sow-stratus.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Stratus Labs Partnerships <partners@stratuslabs.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Oct 2025 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Listing & co-sell: Stratus pilot (initial ask)

Hi Elena — thanks, this looks promising. Looping in Ben (co-sell/commercial) and Karthik (technical evidence) to own next steps. Quick notes and asks from Redwood to get the ball rolling:

1) Evidence checklist (attached): please upload the items below to the shared Drive folder we created. Required for marketplace intake: SOC 2 Type II report (or approval plan), public privacy policy, sample billing SKU list, and product artifact that demonstrates runtime isolation. Optional but recommended: integration architecture diagram and customer success case study.

2) Legal/contracting: we prefer to spin the initial offer as a co-sell pilot SOW + marketplace listing addendum; if you can flag any clauses you expect to redline we can pre-empt.

3) Timeline: proposed internal milestones — co-sell deck draft by Oct 17, marketplace evidence uploaded by Oct 20, legal sign by Oct 24, canary listing target Oct 27. If any of these are blockers, tell us which dates won't work.

Ben, can you take point on the joint deck & sales enablement? Karthik, please confirm the minimal telemetry/metering hooks needed for our metering shim.

I've attached the marketplace-evidence-checklist.pdf to make this concrete.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Director, Alliances | Redwood Inference
olga@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0199
[attachment: marketplace-evidence-checklist.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Stratus Labs Partnerships <partners@stratuslabs.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Oct 2025 13:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Listing & co-sell: Stratus pilot — MAP & assets

Thanks — I've sketched a short mutual action plan (MAP) for clarity. High-level items and owners: 

- Co-sell deck (Ben) — first draft due Oct 17. Will include partner value props, joint messaging, target ICP, and one-pager sales play.
- Marketplace listing metadata (Stratus + Olga) — SKU names, descriptions, pricing model, and icons — evidence to Drive by Oct 20.
- Technical intake (Karthik) — validation of metering shim and runtime compatibility; will confirm required artifacts by Oct 9. Jira reference: ENG-1298.
- Legal/commercial (Olga + Stratus legal) — review tracked SOW changes; target sign Oct 24. DocuSign link to follow.
- Canaries & measurement (Ben + Stratus CS) — plan telemetry events to validate purchase/activation flow during canary. Canaries Oct 27-31.

Link to shared folder with a skeleton deck and intake spreadsheet: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c4d5e6f

Attaching a rough co-sell deck template for your review. I'll iterate the messaging once we have the SKU mapping.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Head of Channel Partnerships | Redwood Inference
[attachment: stratus_co-sell_deck_v1.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Stratus Labs Partnerships <partners@stratuslabs.io>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 09 Oct 2025 09:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Listing & co-sell: Stratus pilot — technical intake notes

Quick technical checklist from my side after a brief review of the prototype agent: 

- Metering: Stratus's agent emits per-customer usage events which can be mapped to our metering shim. We need a stable event name set (example: stratus.events.bytes_ingested, stratus.events.query_count).
- Isolation: provide a short architecture diagram showing tenant separation and how API keys are scoped.
- Logs & evidence: redacted sample logs + a pointer to SOC2 controls mapping.

I've opened ENG-1298 to track the validation work and added acceptance criteria. If we anticipate any custom integration work (e.g., adapting the shim to their protobuf schema), estimate ~1-2 dev weeks.

Vivek — can you confirm co-sell entitlements we can offer for the pilot (lead routing, deal registration, referral credit)? I'll attach a short tech checklist to the Drive. DocuSign will be used for the co-sell addendum; I'll paste the envelope link once ready.

—Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-1298]
